hints.merchantLogin: Set when you created the store in your Robokassa account.
hints.hashAlgorithm: Computes and verifies payment signatures. Must match the algorithm in the store's technical settings in Robokassa.
hints.password1: Signs the payment and capture requests. From the store's technical settings in Robokassa.
hints.password2: Verifies payment notifications and signs payment status requests. From the store's technical settings in Robokassa.
hints.capture: When on, the payment is one-stage and the money is debited right away. When off, it is two-stage and the amount is held until you capture it.
hints.isTest: Sends payments in the Robokassa test mode and signs them with the test passwords.
hints.testPassword1: Used instead of password #1 while test mode is on.
hints.testPassword2: Used instead of password #2 while test mode is on.
hints.useReceipt: Sends receipt data with every payment for registration under 54-FZ.
hints.taxation: Applies to the whole receipt. Items under different tax systems must be sent in separate receipts.
hints.taxItemDefault: Applied to every product line of the receipt.
hints.taxShippingDefault: Applied to the shipping line of the receipt.

taxation.usn_income_outcome: Simplified taxation system (STS), income minus expenses
